{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|gr1= Object Manipulation

|descr= Returns how many seconds injured unit will continue leaving blood trail. If unit damage is < 0.1, the return value is 0 and unit doesn't leave any blood trail. Use [[setBleedingRemaining]] to set different remaining time.

|s1= [[getBleedingRemaining]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>_bleedingRemaining = getBleedingRemaining _unit;</sqf>

|seealso= [[isBurning]] [[setBleedingRemaining]] [[isBleeding]]
}}
